Definition: from Διόνυσος (Bacchus); reveller; Dionysius, an Athenian:--Dionysius.
BiblicalUsage: Dionysius the Areopagite, one of the few in Athens who believed Paul's preaching about the resurrection and joined him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps a remnant even in the proudest city, and one listener who believes is worth the whole sermon.
